```artifact
Feature: Maintain Doctors and Chemists/Labs
  As an administrator,
  I want to manage doctors and chemists/labs,
  So that I can ensure accurate and up-to-date information.

  Scenario: Attempt to access a non-existent speciality
    Given a speciality with ID "9999" does not exist
    When I attempt to access the speciality with ID "9999"
    Then an exception error message "Speciality does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario Outline: Add a new doctor
    Given I am on the Add Doctor Screen
    When I enter the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <name>      | <age>| <sex>| <qualification>| <experience> |
    And I submit the form
    Then a new doctor is added with a generated Doctor ID
    And the doctor details are as follows:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <name>      | <age>| <sex>| <qualification>| <experience> |

    Examples:
      | name        | age | sex | qualification | experience |
      | Dr. John Doe| 45  | M   | MBBS          | 10         | # Normal case
      | Dr. Jane    | 30  | F   | MD            | 5          | # Normal case
      | Dr. A       | 25  | M   | MBBS          | 2          | # Edge case - minimum age
      | Dr. B       | 100 | F   | MD            | 40         | # Edge case - maximum age
      | Dr. C       | 0   | M   | MBBS          | 0          | # Invalid case - zero age
      | Dr. D       | -1  | F   | MD            | -5         | # Invalid case - negative values

  Scenario Outline: Edit an existing doctor
    Given a doctor with ID "<doctor_id>" exists with the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <name>      | <age>| <sex>| <qualification>| <experience> |
    When I navigate to the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    And I query the doctor with ID "<doctor_id>"
    And I update the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <new_name>  | <new_age>| <new_sex>| <new_qualification>| <new_experience> |
    And I submit the form
    Then the doctor details are updated as follows:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <new_name>  | <new_age>| <new_sex>| <new_qualification>| <new_experience> |

    Examples:
      | doctor_id | name        | age | sex | qualification | experience | new_name      | new_age | new_sex | new_qualification | new_experience |
      | 1         | Dr. John Doe| 45  | M   | MBBS          | 10         | Dr. John Smith| 46      | M     | MBBS              | 11             | # Normal case
      | 2         | Dr. Jane    | 30  | F   | MD            | 5          | Dr. Jane Doe  | 31      | F     | MD                | 6              | # Normal case
      | 3         | Dr. A       | 25  | M   | MBBS          | 2          | Dr. A         | 26      | M     | MBBS              | 3              | # Edge case - minimum age
      | 4         | Dr. B       | 100 | F   | MD            | 40         | Dr. B         | 101     | F     | MD                | 41             | # Edge case - maximum age
      | 5         | Dr. C       | 0   | M   | MBBS          | 0          | Dr. C         | 1       | M     | MBBS              | 1              | # Invalid case - zero age
      | 6         | Dr. D       | -1  | F   | MD            | -5         | Dr. D         | 1       | F     | MD                | 1              | # Invalid case - negative values

  Scenario: Attempt to edit a non-existent doctor
    Given a doctor with ID "9999" does not exist
    When I attempt to edit the doctor with ID "9999"
    Then an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario: Attempt to delete a doctor with open consultation requests
    Given a doctor with ID "1" has open consultation requests
    When I attempt to delete the doctor with ID "1"
    Then an exception error message "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" is displayed

  Scenario Outline: Add a new chemist/lab
    Given I am on the Add Chemist/Lab Screen
    When I enter the following details:
      | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | <flag>           | <name>           | <address>           | <contact_details>         |
    And I submit the form
    Then a new chemist/lab is added with a generated Chemist/Lab ID
    And the chemist/lab details are as follows:
      | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | <flag>           | <name>           | <address>           | <contact_details>         |

    Examples:
      | flag | name          | address         | contact_details     |
      | C    | Chemist X     | 123 Main St     | 1234567890          | # Normal case
      | L    | Lab Y         | 456 Elm St      | 0987654321          | # Normal case
      | C    | C             | A               | 1                   | # Edge case - minimum length
      | L    | L             | B               | 2                   | # Edge case - minimum length
      | C    |               |                 |                     | # Invalid case - empty fields
      | L    |               |                 |                     | # Invalid case - empty fields
```
